newsitem.title: MEXICO: Carso lowers cigarette prices in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Carso lowers cigarette prices in Mexico.

text.p: Mexican conglomerate Grupo Carso has temporarily lowered prices on its Marlboro and Marlboro Light brand cigarettes sold in Mexico, the company said in newspaper advertisements on Friday.

Carso's cigarette unit Cigatam said it has temporarily lowered the price of a pack of Marlboro and Marlboro Light cigarettes to 8 pesos from 10 pesos. It did not say how long the price cut would last.
The company said the move was aimed at stemming the tide of counterfeit Marlboro cigarettes in Mexico.
